title: Toy proves too quick for lazy cat who keeps getting smacked and barely reacts
description:
Comical footage has surfaced of a cat realizing that her new toy is just too fast for her!

"I saw my cat getting hit with her toy repeatedly," the filmer, Emily, told WooGlobe.

The silly feline clearly isn’t a fan of being struck from both directions. What makes it even funnier is that she doesn't make a big enough move to escape the chaos for good.

Either she was simply exhausted, or she was busy calculating every possible pattern in hopes of dodging the hits more effectively next time.
